name: mcp__flow.list_comments
description: List comments on a Flow issue, project, initiative, document, project milestone, or project/initiative status update. Provide exactly one of `issueId`, `projectId`, `initiativeId`, `documentId`, `milestoneId`, or `statusUpdateId`. For issues, projects, and initiatives this returns both top-level discussion threads and inline description comments. Inline (anchored) comments carry a non-null `quotedText` set to the snippet of description text they reference. Returned comments include `author` and nullable `onBehalfOf`; when set, `onBehalfOf` identifies the user the agent author acted for.

documentId.description: Document ID or slug (provide exactly one parent)

initiativeId.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., INIT-123), or slug (provide exactly one parent)

issueId.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123) (provide exactly one parent)

milestoneId.description: Milestone UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve milestone names via `list_milestones` first.

projectId.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., PROJ-123), or slug (provide exactly one parent)

statusUpdateId.description: Status update UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve status updates via `get_status_updates` first.

statusUpdateType.description: Type of status update named by `statusUpdateId`, as returned by `get_status_updates`. Only valid together with `statusUpdateId`; omit to check both project and initiative status updates.

name: mcp__flow.save_issue
description: Create or update a Flow issue. If `id` is provided, updates the existing issue; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `title` and `team` are required. Note: use `assignee` (not `assigneeId`) to set the assignee — it accepts a user ID, name, email, or "me". To hand work to an AI agent, set `delegate` (with optional `delegateInstructions`). Pass `archived` to archive or restore an existing issue.

archived.description: Archive (true) or unarchive (false) an existing issue

delegate.description: Agent (app user) ID or name to delegate the issue to; null removes the delegate. The human assignee stays responsible.

delegateInstructions.description: Instructions for the agent in `delegate`. Only valid when `delegate` names a new agent; they become the agent's task prompt.

description.description: Markdown body. Images written as ![alt](url) render inline. Prefer attaching files with prepare_attachment_upload so Flow inserts them into this description automatically.

items.description: One of replace, insert_before, insert_after, prepend, append, replace_range patch objects, same shape as save_initiative.patch.

recurrence.description: Repeat the issue on this schedule; null or "" stops it recurring. Presets: daily, weekdays, weekly, biweekly, monthly, yearly (weekly/monthly/yearly repeat on today's weekday/day). Or an RRULE subset: FREQ=DAILY|WEEKLY|MONTHLY|YEARLY with optional INTERVAL=n (1-99), BYDAY=MO,WE (weekly), BYMONTHDAY=n or -1 for last day (monthly/yearly), BYDAY=2TU or -1FR (Nth/last weekday of month), BYMONTH=1-12 (yearly). Example: FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=MO,FR. Each occurrence creates a new issue due that day and moves the schedule to it.

name: mcp__flow.create_attachment
description: Deprecated fallback for tiny files only. Accepts base64 file content, verifies SHA-256 checksum, and uploads it through the MCP worker. The file is inserted into the issue description as an inline image, video, or file card. Prefer `prepare_attachment_upload` plus direct PUT plus `create_attachment_from_upload`.

base64Content.description: Deprecated base64-encoded file content to upload

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 hex digest of the decoded file bytes.

size.description: Optional expected decoded file size in bytes. Rejects the upload if it does not match.

name: mcp__flow.save_comment
description: Create or update a comment on a Flow issue, project, initiative, document, project milestone, or project/initiative status update. If `id` is provided, updates the existing comment; otherwise creates a new one. To start a new thread, pass `body` and exactly one of `issueId`, `projectId`, `initiativeId`, `documentId`, `milestoneId`, or `statusUpdateId` — comments on issues/projects/initiatives become top-level discussion threads; comments on documents/milestones become description comments. A status update holds a single thread, so a comment on an update that already has one is added to it as a reply. To reply to an existing thread, pass `parentId` and `body`; the reply inherits the parent's thread type, so no entity reference is needed. Parent reference fields are ignored when `id` or `parentId` is provided (`statusUpdateType` is rejected instead).

body.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe)

id.description: Comment ID. If provided, updates the existing comment

initiativeId.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., INIT-123), or slug (provide exactly one parent)

issueId.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123) (provide exactly one parent)

milestoneId.description: Milestone UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve milestone names via `list_milestones` first.

parentId.description: Parent comment ID (for replies, only when creating)

projectId.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., PROJ-123), or slug (provide exactly one parent)

statusUpdateId.description: Status update UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve status updates via `get_status_updates` first.

statusUpdateType.description: Type of status update named by `statusUpdateId`, as returned by `get_status_updates`. Only valid together with `statusUpdateId`; omit to check both project and initiative status updates.

name: mcp__flow.save_team
description: Create or update a Flow team. Without `id`, creates a team exactly like Settings → Create a team (the viewer becomes its owner; default workflow states and settings are applied, or copied from `copySettingsFrom`/`parentTeam`); `name` and `key` are required. With `id`, updates the team. Team settings (`description`, `timezone`, `triageEnabled`, cycles) and membership changes use the same permissions as the team settings pages. `states` and `labels` add new team workflow states and team labels.

private.description: Private teams are visible only to their members

parentTeam.description: Create as a sub-team of this team (ID, key, or name). Create only.

copySettingsFrom.description: Copy settings and workflow states from this team (ID, key, or name). Create only.

triageEnabled.description: Turn the team's triage inbox on or off

members.description: Users to add as team members (name, email, ID, or "me")

removeMembers.description: Users to remove from the team (update only)

states.description: Workflow states to add to the team

description: Create or edit a Flow label. With `id` (label ID or unique name), edits its name, description, color, or archived state. Without `id`, creates a label: `type` chooses issue (default), project, or initiative labels; `team` makes it a team label (issue/project only); `parent` places it in an existing label group. Follows the workspace/team label permissions.

id.description: Label ID or unique name to edit. Omit to create.

team.description: Team ID, key, or name for a team-scoped label (create only)

parent.description: Label group name or ID (create only)

name: mcp__flow.save_view
description: Create or update a saved Flow issue view (a custom view with filters). Without `id`, `name` is required. `filters` uses the issue filter bar's model: each filter has a `field`, an `operator` (is | isNot) and `values`; names are resolved for you (status names or types, users/"me"/"none", priority 0-4 or Urgent/High/Medium/Low/No priority, label names, project names/"none", cycle names/numbers). Setting `filters` replaces all filters. `scope` personal | team | workspace; giving `team` implies a team view. `shared: true` creates a public share link, `false` revokes it.

id.description: View ID, slug, or name to update. Omit to create.

team.description: Team ID, key, or name for a team view; null to make it a workspace view

shared.description: Create (true) or revoke (false) the view's public share link

Documents can belong to a project, a team, and/or an issue (Flow documents do not attach to initiatives). `template` starts a new document from a document template.

name: mcp__flow.save_template
description: Create or update a Flow template. `type` is issue, project, or document. Issue templates prefill new issues (`title`, `body` Markdown, `state`, `priority`, `assignee`, `project`, `labels`); without `team` they are workspace templates. Project templates prefill projects (`projectName`, `summary`, `description`, `teams`, `labels`, `lead`, `priority`). Document templates need a `team` and take Markdown `content`. Without `id`, `name` is required. Uses the same template permissions as settings.

id.description: Template ID or name to update. Omit to create.

description.description: Issue/document template: description shown in the template picker. Project template: the project description.

templateDescription.description: Project template: description shown in the template picker

team.description: Team ID, key, or name (issue templates: team template; document templates: required when creating)

state.description: Issue template: status name, type, or ID (requires a team)

assignee.description: Issue template: default assignee; null to clear

project.description: Issue template: default project; null to clear

teams.description: Project template: teams (ID, key, or name)

name: mcp__flow.triage_issue
description: Act on an issue in a team's Triage inbox, like the Triage page: `accept` moves it into the team's workflow (optionally into `state` and with a `priority`; teams that require a priority reject accepting without one), `decline` moves it to the canceled state, `duplicate` links it to `duplicateOf` and closes it as a duplicate, `snooze` hides it until `snoozedUntil`. An optional `comment` is posted on the issue.

id.description: Issue ID or identifier in triage

state.description: accept: target status name, type, or ID (defaults to the team's default non-triage status)

duplicateOf.description: duplicate: the canonical issue ID or identifier

snoozedUntil.description: snooze: ISO date/time or ISO-8601 duration such as P1D or P1W

comment.description: Optional comment to post with the decision

name: mcp__flow.update_notification

snoozedUntil.description: Snooze until an ISO date/time or ISO-8601 duration (PT3H, P1D); null to unsnooze

markAllRead.description: Mark every notification in the inbox as read

name: mcp__flow.save_agent_skill
description: Create or update a Flow Agent skill: reusable instructions the agent can follow. Without `team`, saves one of the viewer's personal skills; with `team`, saves a team skill in that team's settings (team settings permission applies) and `enabled` turns it on or off. Without `id`, `name` and `instructions` are required.

team.description: Team ID, key, or name for a team skill

enabled.description: Team skills only: whether the skill is active

name: mcp__flow.save_loop
description: Create or update a Flow loop (an automation the agent runs on a schedule or when issues, projects, initiatives, releases, teams, or cycles change). Without `id` it creates a draft (`name` or `templateId` required); pass `publish: true` (or `status: "published"`) to create or publish it, which also enables it. Schedules use `interval`/`unit`/`time`/`startDate`/`weekdays`/`timezone`; event triggers use `event`, optional `value` (what the property was set to; null = none), `teams`, and `filters`. `instructions` is the prompt the agent follows on every run.

id.description: Loop ID or name to update. Omit to create a draft.

description.description: One-line summary; generated automatically when omitted

instructions.description: What the agent should do on each run

templateId.description: Start a new draft from a template

status.description: draft or published; a published loop cannot return to draft

publish.description: Publish (create) the loop and enable it

weekdays.description: schedule: only run on these weekdays (day or week units)

event.description: event triggers: issue: created, updated, triage (enters triage), status, priority, assignee, agent, project, team, labels, comment, customerRequest; project/initiative: created, updated, status, update; release: created, updated, status; team: created, updated; cycle: created, started, completed

value.description: event triggers: the value the property changed to (status name, priority 0-4 or label, person, project, team, label name); "any" or omitted for any; null for none (No assignee)

teams.description: event triggers: only react to these teams (ID, key, or name); empty for all

filters.description: event triggers: extra conditions on the issue

team.description: Owning team for team-level loops (ID, key, or name)

allowChangesOutsideTrigger.description: Allow the loop to change resources other than the one that triggered it

allowExternalSync.description: Allow changes to issues and comments synced from other tools

owner.description: User the loop runs as (name, email, ID, or "me")
